verified_correction: The assistant will not create Legacy decision rules that the Founder did not direct.
Mass production is not an authorized default and will not occur unless the Founder explicitly requests multiple outputs/variants.

When the Founder directs an edit to a rendering previously marked failed/rejected, that exact rendering is the edit target and the exact Founder edit is executed; prior status does not authorize substitution.
Python and GitHub preflight check the assistant's understanding before the image action; they do not absorb accountability for execution.
A recurrence triggers Verification -> Mirror Review of assistant execution -> Verification before the next action.
Existing ML-012/014/018/019 controls are applied without overriding Founder-directed edits or inventing an alternate workflow.
open_proof_requirement: The visual-execution correction remains open until the next Founder-requested visual/edit is executed correctly and the actual finished artifact passes the Verification -> Review -> Verification process.
